ValidationRule.description: Requires a DQ reason if Disqualified is selected for person status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Contact_Status__c , "Disqualified"), ISBLANK(Text(Disqualified_Reason__c)), NOT($UserRole.Name = "Admin") ) && Contact_Automation_Bypassed__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Disqualified reason must be filled in.
